---
name: 🐛 Bug report
about: Something is broken (docs, numbers, links, artifacts)
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what is wrong.

**Where**
- [ ] README / README.zh
- [ ] docs/ (faq, deployment, cost-savings, protocol, reproduce, technical-report, gallery)
- [ ] BENCHMARKS.md / MODEL_CARD.md
- [ ] figures/ or docs/gallery/ assets (GIF/png/svg)
- [ ] SHA256SUMS mismatch
- [ ] Release artifacts on HF / ModelScope

**File & line** (if applicable)
Path and line where you spotted it.

**Expected vs actual**
What the doc/asset should say/show vs what it does.

**Screenshots** (if applicable)

**Additional context**
Note: reported metrics are frozen — if you believe a number is wrong, please also attach
your independent reproduction (script + measured value) so we can add it as a labelled
reproduction column.
